sources.title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free
sources.version: arXiv v1, 2025-05-10; this supplement binds this version, not all later model implementations
sources.supports: G1 follows SDPA and precedes the output projection. Gate input is pre-normalized hidden state. Head specificity and scalar/vector granularity are separate choices. Attention-sink reduction is an empirical trained-model observation.
sources.limits: The fixed local calculation is not author training, a trained-model replication, or a speed measurement. No unpublished hyperparameters are inferred.

sources.title: Qwen3-Next: Towards Ultimate Training & Inference Efficiency
sources.version: Publisher page dated 2025-09-10; retrieved 2026-10-30 from indexed official page text because direct HTML rendering was empty
sources.supports: The publisher explicitly links its standard-attention output gating to the above prior work, separately from Gated DeltaNet layers.
sources.limits: A mutable publisher page is not a fixed code revision; its architecture and speed claims are not locally reproduced. It does not establish every Qwen3.5 implementation detail.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B official model card
sources.version: c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a; previously archived and verified in the GDN/KDA round
sources.supports: The specified 9B card names an 8-group 3-GDN-plus-1-Gated-Attention layout.
sources.limits: Only a crosslink to the existing model-card evidence; this card alone does not establish gate tensor granularity or complete training recipes.

localScope: Three given logits and two-dimensional values; learned 2x2 gate and output projections; 17 local finite differences; one gate-only SGD step; algebraic placement and later-query cache counterexamples.
